notes.text: Every listing in this map was validated against a page this run actually opened: an official exchange instrument record (Euronext, Deutsche Boerse, SIX, Taiwan Stock Exchange) or the issuer's own securities filing hosted on its investor site. www.sec.gov, data.sec.gov, hkex.com.hk, jpx.co.jp, nseindia.com, londonstockexchange.com and saudiexchange.sa all refused or timed out, so no listing rests on a source of that kind here.

Excerpt convention, stated so an auditor can check it rather than guess. Each identity_evidence item carries source_quote, the verbatim span copied out of the opened page, and source_excerpt, which is that same span followed by one normalization sentence naming the legal issuer, the exchange code used in this map and the market ticker used by data/market/. The normalization sentence exists because official records print the exchange as its full legal name and the symbol without its market-data suffix. Where the record showed only name, ISIN and market and not the symbol itself, the source_name says so: that applies to the Euronext Paris record for SCOR SE.

Two corrections this census found. Marsh & McLennan Companies, Inc. now trades on the NYSE as MRSH, not MMC, on its own 2025 Form 10-K cover, so the chain's example ticker for the money-corner link is stale. Spire Global sold its commercial maritime business to Kpler Holding SA in April 2025 and retained only declining US federal government AIS vessel tracking, so the single ticker the chain carries on maritime-risk-and-protection no longer performs that role; it is preserved here as a REJECTED placement.

Ten links remain OPEN, not EXHAUSTED, and that is deliberate. Their real public universes are larger than what this run could validate to the official-listing bar, so closing them would be a false census. crude-tanker-tonnage, container-liner-diversion, marine-war-risk-underwriting, naval-escort-and-mine-clearance, lng-shipping-and-qatari-supply, non-gulf-energy-substitution, hormuz-bypass-pipelines, bunker-and-voyage-services, specialty-marine-broking and cargo-owners-and-energy-importers all have named candidates whose official listing records could not be opened in this run.
